title: Vice President, Head of Asset Management
description:
**About Lydian Energy**

Lydian is an established energy development company specializing in the development and construction of utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects in North America. Lydian owns 14 assets in development, construction or under operation, consisting of both solar and storage, which reached or are expected to reach FNTP from 2024-2028.

Lydian is backed by Excelsior Energy Capital (“EEC”), a leading private equity fund manager with more than $1.5B in assets under management, that is exclusively focused on north American middle market renewables investing. Lydian’s relationship with EEC provides several critical advantages, including access to (i) a specialized team of value-add investor-operators with decades of renewables development, construction, and transaction experience and (ii) committed discretionary equity capital, strong relationships with debt and tax equity investors, and deep experience structuring tax equity and project financings.

Lydian has built a team of seasoned, passionate energy infrastructure professionals with deep expertise in project development, construction, financing, and M&A. This is an opportunity to join a fully capitalized development platform that is running at full capacity, but still at an early-enough stage for you to have a real impact on company culture and commercial outcomes.

**Job Scope**

The Vice President of Asset Management reports to the Chief Operating Officer and is responsible for maximizing the long-term performance and financial returns of the company’s operating renewable energy portfolio. This leader oversees third-party O&M provider management, revenue optimization, operating cost control, and all third-party reporting obligations including to lenders, tax equity investors, and offtakers. title: Lead Engineer
description:
**Lead Engineer**

**Saber Power Services,** a portfolio company of Greenbelt Capital Partners, is a fully integrated electrical power system services firm providing end-to-end solutions across utility, renewables and battery storage, industrial, petrochemical, and other markets. Based in Houston, Texas, Saber Power offers deep subject matter expertise and uses an engineering-led approach to designing, installing, testing, and maintaining medium and high-voltage electrical infrastructure. Saber serves clients locally, nationally, and abroad.  
  
**Position Summary:**

The Lead Engineer is responsible for providing technical leadership, engineering oversight, and project execution for high-voltage electrical infrastructure projects, including substations, transmission systems, renewable energy interconnections, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and utility modernization initiatives. This role serves as the engineering lead for multidisciplinary EPC projects from conceptual design through commissioning while ensuring technical excellence, safety, schedule adherence, budget performance, and client satisfaction.

The ideal candidate is an experienced Professional Engineer with extensive expertise in transmission and distribution substation design, engineering management, utility standards, and the successful delivery of complex EPC projects. This individual will mentor engineering teams, interface directly with clients and utilities, and drive continuous improvements in engineering processes and project execution.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Lead multidisciplinary engineering teams on high-voltage EPC projects ranging from 12kV through 500kV.
* Serve as Engineer of Record (EOR) where applicable and provide technical oversight throughout the project lifecycle.
* Direct engineering activities from conceptual design through detailed engineering, procurement support, construction, commissioning, and project closeout.

title: Data Center Capacity Delivery, Canada
description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Senior Data Center Capacity Delivery Manager at Anthropic, you'll embed with project teams responsible for delivery of leased and partnered data center capacity. Your primary role will be to lead these partners to deliver on the fastest possible schedule while maintaining a safe construction site and protecting the finished quality of the data center. Additionally, you'll validate deal readiness, coordinate complex stakeholder relationships, maintain regular reporting and status tracking, and ensure seamless transitions from project inception through operational readiness.  This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Anthropic secures and activates the compute infrastructure needed to train and deploy frontier AI systems, working at the intersection of real estate, construction, and cutting-edge AI infrastructure. You will be at one or more project sites 60% of the time or more and expected to shape the culture, approach, and aggressiveness that define those extended site teams. The goal is to impact outcomes in a favorable manner. You are expected to be a force multiplier that develops and enhances the skillset that development partners, general contractors, and key trades bring to the project(s) you are overseeing. That means being a subject matter expert in the various cross functional elements of data center delivery and increasing the team's performance with that knowledge and commitment to alignment. As part of AMD’s Ecosystem team you will help bring structure, clarity, and execution discipline to the complex memory and storage partner ecosystem landscape.
